steps.do: Confirm styles.css declares the dark palette inside a prefers-color-scheme media query.

traps: Presentation attributes such as fill="var(--series-1)" do not resolve var(), so the bar reads black or empty. Put the fill in a CSS rule or a style attribute instead.
Skipping page.emulateMedia runs the test in light mode, so it passes without checking the dark palette. Always emulate the scheme explicitly.
Do not hard-code the expected RGB in the test. Read the value from the :root token so the test follows the stylesheet.

steps.do: List every data-theme selector in styles.css with its line number.

K-019352.check: grep shows a line such as 30: [data-theme=light] and Playwright prints 1 passed.
traps: Setting data-theme on body instead of html breaks the :root token lookup, so the override never applies.
A [data-theme=dark] rule that comes before the media query can lose the cascade, so check the order of rules.
A toggle that only changes the class name does nothing unless the stylesheet selects that class.

steps.do: Install the axe Playwright package if it is not already in the project.

traps: Running axe in light mode reports nothing about dark colors, so the test must emulate dark first.

A 4.5:1 minimum applies to text, while chart graphics need 3:1 under WCAG 1.4.11.

steps.do: List the series color tokens in theme.css with line numbers.

traps: Relative luminance uses linearized sRGB, so comparing raw hex values by eye gives wrong results.

A series that passes 3:1 can still collide with another series, so also compare series against each other.
